percentage_basis.method: Historical denominator for stages 1 and 2 and the all-code completion batch; excludes .meta, scenes, resources and build helpers.

full_content_inventory.counting_rule: Count every tracked regular file under the canonical Unity project once, including source and metadata, scenes, Resources, other Assets, Packages and ProjectSettings. Exclude generated Unity folders and repository files outside unity/.
full_content_inventory.deferred_batch_measure: For the post-code content phase, count distinct canonical tracked files against this complete 197-file denominator; every file is indivisible and counts once. The cap is floor(10% * 197) = 19 files per batch. Keep dependencies and .meta pairs together; bytes are reported for context, not used as the percentage denominator. Re-inventory and recalculate if the official Unity source commit changes.

cumulative_full_apk_policy: Every stage builds a complete Android APK from the accumulated unity-bootstrap project. Preserve stages 1 and 2, then add all remaining canonical runtime C# scripts in one code-completion batch to reach 100% of the pinned 16,988-line code inventory. Keep scenes, Resources, new source .meta files and other excluded Unity project content out of that batch. Only after its APK passes, migrate the remaining full Unity project content in dependency-closed batches of no more than 10% of the complete tracked-content inventory. Do not prescribe a fixed number of batches. A successful APK is not runtime or content parity.
